RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Bruk Oleen
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: won the right to his trade at twenty, tusks against his own cousin.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: eighty-one years on the same cracking tower.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: Four feet of grievance in a leather apron. He remembers every mistake you have ever made on his floor and will recite them in order, and he is never once wrong, which is worse.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Ferrin Oleen
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: lost the duel. Kept the job. Never got over either.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: clears the settling sump, badly drunk, extremely well.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: He'll tell you about the breath-hold record inside four minutes of meeting you, in a voice like a hinge, and he'll tell you again tomorrow. Leave a bottle where he can see it and you lose him for two days.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Tenno Vurr
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: saltwater took his sense of taste before he was ten, as it takes every Chagrian's.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: runs a refinery mess by smell alone and is better at it than anyone has explained.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: Tongue out, flick, adjust — he tastes your dinner with his nose and hands it over without looking. He eats nutrient capsules standing up in nine seconds. He has never once sat down to a meal in his life and finds the idea faintly obscene.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Poul Adden-Adden
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: pushed out of the family unit at seven and traded to a household that wanted a
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: junior stockman, convinced he is management-track.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: He's blue, he's round, he introduces himself with both names every single time, and he is under the immovable impression that he is being observed for promotion. He took this job for the meals. He would take a worse one for better meals and will tell you so proudly.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Margrave Sarrick
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: nomad. Rode a flying reptile before he could read.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: eleven years offworld on a gate, reading every manifest that passes, looking for one
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: Seven feet of silent cat in a doorway, and he has never drawn on anyone here. He made the scimitar on his back himself and has twice refused a year's passage for it. Ask him why he's on this rock and he will simply stop talking to you.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Jat Hessik
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: fled a clan feud and will not say which clan.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: best pipe-fitter on the tower. Works nights. Cold-blooded.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: Wrapped in three stolen thermal layers and shaking by the fourth hour, because he is cold-blooded and they gave him the night gang as a joke six years ago. He is better than all of them. He has never asked to be moved.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Ossuk Rell
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: failed the third examination at nineteen. Will not say which one.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: keeps a perfect book on a tower beneath him, and runs the little oil shop at the gate.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: Two metres of pale disapproval with three hearts, two of which he consciously runs hot to keep his hands warm, and he is mortified to be seen doing it. He is visibly appalled by everyone here. He is also the only one who shows up when Ferrin is bad.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Adda Wesh
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: dock brat. Learned manifests before letters.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: the only loadmaster permitted to tell a Hutt factor he is wrong.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: A gimpy walk from a crate that came down in '48 and a voice like a rasp on tin. She drinks the night gang under the table twice a season and reminds them of it for the other fifty-one weeks. Two promotions lost to her mouth and she'd lose a third tomorrow.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Gand
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: earned a surname young. Witnessed, entered, real.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: gave it back after one consignment went to the wrong world.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: He has no name. He speaks of himself in the third person and signs every docket "Gand", and when you ask him to write it properly he writes it the same. He sleeps two hours in six days. He does not breathe like anything you have met.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Buba Nokk
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: hauled freight for an uncle who bet the family's stake and lost it.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: does the same, on his own wages, every payday, at the same table.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: Two and a half metres of apologetic whale who cannot fit through the personnel door and must be let in through the freight hatch, every shift, by someone. He clears his blowhole before saying anything important — a great wet *hauum* that silences the shed — and then says something like "the small crates go on top."

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Sen Ilva
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: raised on kolto rigs her people no longer own.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: dock medic, in a suit that hisses.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: You hear her before you see her: the misting vents cycle every eleven seconds and she has never fixed them. She will not approach you unless you signal her first — approaching the unwilling is a rudeness she physically cannot commit — so half the injuries here reach her late and she knows it and cannot stop.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Orrin Kwaad
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: unremarkable, by every account including his own.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: gate scanner. Takes forty credits to look at a manifest for slightly less time.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: Forty. Not four hundred — forty, for six years, never once raised, which unsettles people more than the theft does. He remembers your children's names and asks after them by name and feels precisely nothing while doing it.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Tikka Vosh
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: born to a house that is owed a debt by another house.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: sorter, day gang, wears a scent-damper and says it is for headaches.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: It is not for headaches. She has known exactly who the night-shift fitter is since her third week and has said nothing for two years. She eats alone, in sight of the gate road, at the hour the night gang walk up.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Factor Ummu Sekk
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: nothing on record and nothing volunteered.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: holds the paper on most of this list.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: She is small, she is sixty, and she speaks so quietly that everyone leans in. She has never raised her voice inside this building and has twice had someone carried out of it. *"Pay, and you are family. Do not pay, and you are inventory. There is no third column."*

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Denno Fash
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: raised under a law that says plant two for every one taken.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: assessor. Will not put a value on anything that came out of a killing.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: A translator collar that mistimes by half a second, so every price he gives arrives after his mouth has stopped. He keeps a seedling tray in a back office on a world where nothing grows, and starts a new one every season, and has never once got one to transplant.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Tobb the Ledger's Boy
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: four hems, two of which he let down himself, badly.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: runs paper between three houses and overcharges on a sliding scale of his own
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: Two glowing eyes and a smell that arrives first. He is a thief, is known to be a thief, and considers this an excellent professional reputation. He will explain at length, to people who did not ask, that the insects living in his hood are correct and that you are the one doing it wrong.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Iss the Quiet
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: given no name, so he could take one that matched wherever he ended up.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: house factotum. Second-best pair of hands in the building at every task and best at
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: Payroll has him at four years. The old man on the door has sat there nineteen and is fairly sure it is longer. He is agreeable, unremarkable, and instantly forgettable in a way that survives being pointed out to you. He has no pulse.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Yesh Adden
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: traded to a kitchen at seven, like all of them.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: fourth kitchen he has run; first where anyone thanked him.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: He cooks with his hands buried in the food because his fingertips do the tasting, which the human staff have privately agreed never to mention. The pump gallery below hurts him — his ears hear into the subsonic — and he has worked above it for eleven years and told nobody.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.label: Old Nabb
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.childhood: not worth recounting, and he will recount it.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.adult: sits on a stool by the door. Nineteen years.
RimMandrake.Inhabited.CharacterDef.hook: He is not a guard and would be no use as one. His entire function is that people arriving to beg for time see a bored old man first instead of Ummu, and it takes something out of them. He knows this. He has one story, about grain, and it is not a good story.
